name: DFW Cubing Summer 2025
information:
- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSummer2025#57421-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSummer2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

## ***Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue, however it is permitted in the foyer outside the expo hall.***

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
